## Install

1. Download **PomTiempo-x.y.z.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **PomTiempo** onto **Applications**.
3. The first time, **right-click PomTiempo → Open** (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → *Open Anyway*). The app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, so macOS asks once.
4. Allow notifications when asked, or later in Settings → Notifications.

Universal build: Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 14 Sonoma or later.
